Mia is interested in singing. Leo wrote about the day in the diary. The weather was rainy that day. Also, his calligraphy fills the shop signs.

Leo thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. The art classroom is one of the best places in the city. There are always many people at the piano room. Also, slow internet can vex even the calmest person.
Leo's favorite animal is the panda. It takes twenty minutes to get to the art classroom by bike. Leo hopes to visit Toronto one day. The path leads downward to a quiet mountain lake.
Leo plays chess with Mia every Saturday. Life is full of small surprises. Leo wants to be a nurse in the future.
